prompt:
A three-panel editorial strip: three equal panels in one horizontal row, separated by clean cream gutters with NO drawn borders or frame lines, on a warm cream ground. The panels read left to right as one progression with ONE consistent world and ONE consistent cast.

THE MAIN FIGURE: a middle-aged Black woman with short natural grey-flecked hair, wearing a rust-colored blazer over a cream blouse. The same woman appears in all three panels and must be recognizably the same person in each.

BEAT ONE: the woman stands at a small wooden lectern, mid-speech, gesturing as if speaking on behalf of the crowd behind her. The crowd behind her is rendered as pale, faint, unfinished grey outlines: unknown people, barely sketched. She holds up an open folder whose pages are completely BLANK, nothing written on them. A translucent amber laptop sits CLOSED and unlit on the lectern's lower shelf.

BEAT TWO: the consequence. The same amber laptop is now OPEN and glowing on a table between the woman and the same crowd. The laptop screen is angled three-quarters toward the viewer so we can see into it. Each crowd member speaks, and a warm amber ribbon travels FROM each person's mouth or raised phone, arcing over and INTO the glowing screen. Inside the screen, a small translucent holographic coral-orange rounded commander wearing an ornate gold admiral hat files each arriving ribbon into a growing wall of small luminous drawers; he exists ONLY inside the screen, never in the room. Crowd members whose ribbons have already landed are painted in full warm color and individual detail, while the farthest few are still pale outlines. The woman watches from beside the table, one hand resting on the laptop lid.

BEAT THREE: the resolution. Back at the same lectern, the open glowing laptop now sits on the lectern facing her. The woman speaks with confidence, one hand on the laptop, the other holding up a single warm amber ribbon like evidence. The whole crowd is now painted in full warm color, varied and individual. One crowd member raises a hand and sends a new amber ribbon toward the lectern, and beside the lectern a simple wooden program board of BLANK cards shows one card visibly sliding to a new position, pushed by that ribbon.

Every crowd member is a different age, build, ethnicity and outfit; never two people matching, never a uniform.

PHYSICAL RELATIONSHIPS, exact: ribbons always travel from the people INTO the laptop screen in beat two, and from one person TOWARD the board in beat three; the closed laptop in beat one is unlit and casts no glow; the open laptop in beats two and three is the only glowing object and casts warm amber light on nearby faces.

TEXT FURNITURE. Render each of these strings EXACTLY, in this placement, and no other text anywhere:
- In the cream margin ABOVE the panels, a title bar in caps: REPRESENTATION IS A CONTEXT PROBLEM
- In the cream gutter directly UNDER panel one: SPEAKING FOR STRANGERS
- In the cream gutter directly UNDER panel two: EVERY VOICE COMPOUNDS
- In the cream gutter directly UNDER panel three: SPEAKING WITH RECEIPTS
- In the cream margin BELOW the panels, a footer bar in caps: IF YOUR KNOWLEDGE DOES NOT COMPOUND, YOUR REPRESENTATION IS A SLOGAN

There are NO signs, posters, banners, or lettering anywhere inside the panels themselves. The folder pages are BLANK, the board cards are BLANK, and the laptop screen contains no readable text. All text sits in the cream margins and gutters, never over the artwork.

ABSOLUTELY NOT: a denim jacket, a jean jacket, any chest patch, any smiley-face badge, any enamel pin, any embroidered emblem, a white tee under an open jacket. No recurring branded character and no identifiable real individual.

warm editorial illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream ground, grounded and human, picture-book register for adults

Do NOT render it in any of these styles: comic-book, cartoon mascot, flat vector, neon, 3D/CGI/Pixar, photoreal, anime, any identifiable recurring individual's face or signature clothing.

These are LOCKED canonical traits of the subject(s). They are not stylistic suggestions and must survive the render exactly: small-blocky-clay-coral-orange-mascot; translucent-holographic-digital-being; casts-light-not-shadow; grand-ornate-gold-admiral-hat; gold-epaulettes; warm-rounded-dot-eyes-with-tiny-catchlights; two-stubby-legs; short-stubby-nub-arms-end-in-rounded-MITTEN-stubs-NEVER-fingers-hands-tubes-or-bars; never-LIVES-in-the-real-world-soft-crossing-allowed-only-at-delivery-leaning-through-the-screen-body-mostly-inside; never-over-anthropomorphized; never-does-task-work-only-listens-commands-delivers; warm-editorial-register-not-comic; clamshell-laptop-form-with-a-visible-physical-keyboard-NEVER-a-tablet; the-WHOLE-laptop-glows-as-a-translucent-holographic-object-not-just-the-screen; glow-colour-is-the-colour-of-the-agent-supercharging-it; screen-FACE-is-visible-to-the-viewer; never-show-the-back-of-the-lid-and-the-screen-face-at-the-same-time; warm-editorial-register; it-is-a-14-INCH-NOTEBOOK-33cm-wide-23cm-deep-21cm-of-screen-when-open; the-open-screen-is-about-TWO-AND-A-QUARTER-TIMES-the-height-of-a-mug-beside-it; it-occupies-about-ONE-QUARTER-of-the-width-of-a-120cm-desk-NEVER-half-NEVER-more; the-lid-is-about-ONE-AND-THREE-QUARTER-SPREAD-HANDS-wide.

Identity of record is reference/chief-of-agents/master.png. Derive EVERY new pose from it (pass master as the FIRST input image), one pose per render; NEVER a multi-pose sheet in a single generation (that drifts the body composition). Keep it a SMALL blocky mascot: clay-coral Anthropic orange (~#D97757), two dot-eyes, two stubby legs, a grand ornate GOLD admiral hat + gold epaulettes (this is what makes it the Chief; sub-agents wear plain white sailor caps, no gold). It is a DIGITAL being: translucent, holographic, glowing, casts LIGHT not shadow, lives inside the computer / the agentverse. Do NOT over-anthropomorphize — no big arms, no human proportions (that was the rejected creepy variant). It never does task work; it only listens, commands, and delivers. CROSSING LAW (Gary 2026-07-16, clarified same day): the Chief never LIVES in the real world; it never stands on a real desk, sits in a real chair, or walks a real room as a free-standing body. The one permitted SOFT CROSSING is delivery: leaning through the screen plane, body mostly inside, to hand an artifact to the human or receive one; artifacts themselves may pass through the glass. Delivery may equally be drawn as work materializing on the screen. emerging.png and delivering.png depict the soft-crossing grammar and remain canon references. LONE-AGENT LAW (Gary 2026-07-16): when a scene shows exactly ONE agent, it is the Chief.

Colour is meaning: orange means Claude Code / the Chief of Agents is running on it; sage-green means Grantwell is; deep indigo means Storywell is. Never mix two agent colours on one machine. The ordinary, un-supercharged laptop stays a plain grey object; the glow is what marks the turn.
